AQPR.name: Acquirer Parameters
AQPR.definition: Acquirer specific configuration parameters for the point of interaction (POI) system.

APPR.name: Application Parameters
APPR.definition: Payment application specific configuration parameters for the point of interaction (POI) system.

TXCP.name: Batch Capture
TXCP.definition: Batch upload of transaction data (data capture of a group of transactions).

AKCP.name: Capture Response
AKCP.definition: Batch download response for the batch capture of transactions.

DLGT.name: Delegation Data
DLGT.definition: Data needed to create a terminal management sub-domain.

MGTP.name: Management Plan
MGTP.definition: Configuration of management plan in the point of interaction.

MRPR.name: Merchant Parameters
MRPR.definition: Merchant configuration parameters for the point of interaction (POI).

SCPR.name: Security Parameters
SCPR.definition: Point of interaction parameters related to the security of software application and application protocol.

STRP.name: Status Report
STRP.definition: Report of software configuration and parameter status.

TRPR.name: Terminal Parameters
TRPR.definition: Point of interaction parameters attached to the terminal as serial number or physical capabilities.

VDPR.name: Vendor Parameters
VDPR.definition: Point of interaction parameters defined by the manufacturer for instance the PIN verification capabilities.

PARA.name: Parameters
PARA.definition: Any combination of configuration parameters for the point of interaction (POI).

TMSP.name: TMS Protocol Parameters
TMSP.definition: Configuration parameters for the TMS protocol.

CRTF.name: Certificate Parameters
CRTF.definition: Certificate provided by a terminal manager.

LOGF.name: Log File
LOGF.definition: Any repository used for recording log traces.

MDFL.name: Media File
MDFL.definition: Media file managed by an application of the POI.

CONF.name: Configuration File
CONF.definition: Configuration file relevant for the POI.

RPFL.name: Report File
RPFL.definition: Report file generated by the POI.

SAPR.name: Sale To POI Protocol Parameters
SAPR.definition: Parameters related to the Sale to POI protocol.

SPRP.name: Service Provider Parameters
SPRP.definition: Service Provider specific parameters for the point of interaction (POI) system.

PROB.name: Probe
PROB.definition: Probe used to monitor a feature on the POI.
